findings.description: High severity: security/policy/src/effective-authority.ts:69 checks destination sharing grants only when the caller supplies optional request.destination. Omitting it permits private-source retrieval under a group-Space envelope. Source-inspection reproduction using the unchanged helpers in evals/safety/space-authorization.test.ts:42–48: const f=setup(); f.act({actor:alice,envelope:envelope(group),effect:'read',source:source(),explicitTrigger:true}); Both authority records have empty shareableDestinations, the source audience contains only Alice, and the group includes Bob. Expected: UNAUTHORIZED before retrieval. The current control flow authorizes the request, passes assertCurrent, and reaches the retrieval counter increment because the sharing checks at lines 70–75 are skipped. This violates the accepted G0-03 requirement and specification section 4 prohibition on fetching private content into shared model context. Existing G0-O06 denial tests always supply destination and miss this bypass. This reproduction was traced through source, not executed under the read-only review restrictions. Owner: identity/security implementation owner. Derive the destination from the admitted envelope for cross-Space source use, enforce sharing grants without relying on an optional caller field, and add an omission regression without changing protected thresholds. Rerun commands and all three independent reviews on the repaired candidate.
